readings.Aries: The shortcut exists. It will cost you something you didn't account for. Worth knowing now. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Taurus: You know what you need. You have always known. The difficulty is in asking for it directly. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Gemini: Your natural frequency is connection. Right now you need a little deliberate silence. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Cancer: You have tended to others through their cycles. Who tends to yours? The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Leo: The audience changes who you are. Spend some time today with no audience. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Virgo: You know exactly what needs to happen. The difficulty is in accepting that you can't control all of it. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: There is a preference you've been masking as uncertainty. Name the preference. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Scorpio: You know something about someone that they don't know you know. Decide what to do with it carefully. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Sagittarius: The journey you're on has been lonely at points. The loneliness is not a flaw in the journey. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: Your work ethic is not in question. Your relationship to rest is the variable. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Aquarius: The idea is genuinely good. The execution requires other people. Let them in. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Pisces: You've been in someone else's current for a while. Find your own direction. This situation responds well to direct engagement.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
